title: T06 — Consume every common pack shipped in the pinned Gauntlet release
goal: Replace the hard-coded smoke-v1 path with discovery of every pack in the pinned artifact, so a pin that adds a pack (0.5.0 added general-assistant-expanded, 28 cases) reaches NERV without a code change
acceptance: model-plan/model-run accept --pack=<id> for any discovered common pack (default neutral-smoke, --format=schema kept); `gauntlet:all` covers every pack at once (refined 2026-11-11: one report per run keeps model-run single-pack)
The generated capability index lists every common pack and every NERV pack with its upstream link at the pinned tag
A regression fails when the artifact ships a pack NERV neither consumes nor excludes with a recorded reason
privacy: Neutral synthetic cases and private local reports only; no secrets, downloads or production effects.
validation: test/gauntlet.test.mjs covers discovery, explicit exclusion and the index across the join with the vendored artifact
npm run gauntlet:plan and check:gauntlet-index pass; no model run
escalation: Excluding a common pack is an owner decision recorded in the evaluation docs

effort.basis: Owner request 2026-11-11: NERV always consumes every common Gauntlet pack plus its own, and a pack added or changed raises a run-new-tests item. Estimate, not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-11 after PR #272 merged with CI 43023793222 green on all five jobs (plan, validate, windows, native-macos, full-suite).
